{"id": "9a774740-ba23-4c21-ac0c-f50f539075ac", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "**SM-04 should report FAIL (non-compliant) for us-east-1.**

- `ListDetectors` returned one detector ID, so GuardDuty was set up in this Region at some point.
- `GetDetector` returned `Status=DISABLED`, so that detector isn't analyzing anything. It isn't ingesting CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs or DNS logs, and it isn't generating findings. That includes findings for SageMaker-related activity, such as notebook instance or execution-role credential misuse.

The check should read this as "GuardDuty is not enabled", not "GuardDuty is enabled". The detector's existence alone doesn't pass the check.

**Suggested finding text:** "A GuardDuty detector exists in us-east-1 (1 detector) but its status is DISABLED. Threat detection is not active in this Region."

- **Evidence limits:** I only have the two responses you gave me. I can't tell when or why the detector was disabled. I also don't know whether findings are being exported or whether an administrator account manages the detector. Neither would change the result, because a disabled detector means no active detection.
- **Scope:** This result covers us-east-1 only.
- **SM-04's definition:** I don't have your SM-04 spec, so this is based on the data and the obvious intent of a GuardDuty check. If your spec has a separate status for "present but disabled", such as a partial pass, use that instead.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
